business_problem: DT needed an efficient, developer-friendly database to speed deployments, reduce time to market, and support a resilient, scalable B2C digital platform for DT’s 30M customers across Germany.
solution_summary: DT needed an efficient, developer-friendly database to speed deployments, reduce time to market, and support a resilient, scalable B2C digital platform for DT’s 30M customers across Germany. DT adopted MongoDB Atlas—spinning up clusters in 10 minutes, enabling developers to start using them within 20 minutes— seamlessly integrating into its ecosystem to build a scalable, agile B2C platform. 1.5M+ daily interactions handled 60M+ records managed Faster time to market Resilient, scalable, and cost-efficient B2C platform delivers mobile, fixed-line, and TV services to millions of customers across 11 countries. It takes a two-part approach: building a unified product layer and a streamlined API layer, which together replace the functions once managed by older CRM systems. “That’s where MongoDB and AWS come in,” says Bharti.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the customer, catalog, and interaction data that powers Deutsche Telekom's personalized user experiences.

data_flow: Application, customer, and workflow data is consolidated in MongoDB Atlas, indexed or enriched where needed, and then delivered to downstream applications, analytics, or AI features through low-latency queries and APIs. Upstream and downstream integrations include AWS, CRM systems, APIs.
